messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT: High inference latency + error spike for hosted vpc-prod (sev-2). Multiple customer pages. Trigger: GPU pool saturation + HPA not reacting. Paging policy: eng-oncall -> 15% CPU above threshold.

olivia (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming scope: which pools and regions? any error codes from customers?

pager-team-bot: Customers: 3 distinct tenants, 2 requests timed out (503), surge at 14:02 UTC.

vikram (sre): quick check — queue depth on request-queue for gpool-us-east-1 is 420 -> backlog. HPA target CPU stayed at 75% but observed node-level GPU utilization is pinned ~99%. Looks like warmup latency is blocking new pods from accepting traffic.

marco (runtime): copying recent logs for the frontend autoscaler:
```
[14:01:12] enqueue request id=6f2a depth=380
[14:01:26] enqueue request id=6f2a depth=410
[14:01:40] hpa: desired_replicas=12 current_replicas=6 cpu_avg=78%
[14:01:40] provisioner: scale_request -> scheduling 6 new GPU nodes (pending)
[14:01:51] warmup: model_load_start node=node-22
[14:03:04] warmup: model_ready node=node-22 load_time=73s
[14:03:05] serve: accept on node-22
[14:03:06] dequeue then serve id=6f2a latency=1250ms
```

jess (platform): summary: autoscaler requested new nodes but pod warmup is ~60-90s depending on model + quantization. HPA looks healthy but HPA only triggers based on CPU/mem; GPU driver-level saturation + long CUDA init causes effective capacity lag.

olivia (oncall): mitigation steps I executed: 1) increased HPA max replicas from 12 -> 20 (temporary) 2) triggered manual scale on dedicated gpu pool to add +8 warm nodes 3) enabled fallback routing to gpool-us-west-2 for new requests. Early metrics show queue depth dropping but still some 503s for requests stuck in pre-warm.

vikram (sre): good. Can someone paste the kube events for the scaled pods? need to confirm create/start/warmup timeline to correlate customer impact window.

infra-logger-bot: kubectl events snippet:
```
14:01:38 Pod replica-7 Pending: Insufficient GPU
14:01:41 Pod replica-7 Scheduled to node-19
14:01:42 Pod replica-7 Pulling image
14:01:50 Pod replica-7 Started container
14:01:51 Pod replica-7 Warning: warmup-latency 65s
14:03:06 Pod replica-7 Ready
14:03:07 Service forwarded traffic to replica-7
```

marco (runtime): hypothesis thread:
- H1: GPU pool saturated -> HPA requested pods but scheduling delayed due to InsufficientGPU => queue accumulation.
- H2: Pods schedule quickly but model cold-start (warmup) takes 60-90s, HPA doesn't account for warmup time so effective capacity lags.
- H3: A recent change in image layering increased model load time (seen in image pull + cold load logs).

jess (platform): collecting metrics for HPA signals and scheduler backlog now. Also fetching EC2/GKE node provisioning times. Will post graphs.

olivia (oncall): customer-impact timeline (from alert + logs):
- 14:00 UTC: traffic surge begins (external customer spike)
- 14:01 UTC: queue depth > 300, errors begin at 14:01:30
- 14:03 UTC: first scaled pods become Ready and start draining backlog
- 14:05 UTC: 90% of queued requests processed, errors drop to baseline
Impact window ~ 4-5 minutes for most requests; some long-wait ones hit 503s.

vikram (sre): for RCA need: full kube events for the pool, HPA metrics (cpu/mem/replica count), GPU util per node, warmup latencies per pod, image digest for pods started 14:01-14:04. Assigning tasks:
- jess: HPA and scheduler metrics + cloud provider node provisioning times (ETA 30m)
- marco: runtime logs + warmup trace per pod + model load stack traces (ETA 20m)
- olivia: customer impact mapping and notify CS for tenants affected (ETA 15m)

olivia (oncall): paging next oncall for handoff — @vikram you're next shift. I'll publish intermediate notes to the incident doc and mark "handoff in-thread" once I sign off.

vikram (sre): ack. Also want to capture an action item: add HPA-awareness about warmup (or a readiness gate that counts warmup) vs relying only on cpu. Creating ticket INF-2312.

marco (runtime): quick debug note: warmup logs show repeated quantize steps causing model load to take extra time. suspect change in last image pushed 2026-01-28 bumped transform library. I'll diff layers and roll a canary with previous image.

jess (platform): posted HPA/replica chart link: https://grafana.company/g/d/auto/hpa-gpool-us-east1 (paste) — shows desired jumps at 14:01 but actual pod readiness lag 70-90s.

olivia (oncall): mitigation summary for postmortem: 1) immediate: temporary max_replicas bump + manual pool scale + cross-region fallback 2) near-term: implement warmup-aware scale (INF-2312) 3) medium-term: reduce model cold-start by optimizing image layers (INF-2313) 4) long-term: predictive pre-warm for expected traffic surges (INF-2314).

pagerduty-bot: Note: incident status moved to "degraded service" -> "recovering" (14:10 UTC)

infra-logger-bot: export of relevant ids for RCA: queued_request_ids: [6f2a, 7b1c, 8f9d], pod_ids: [replica-7, replica-8, replica-9], image_digest_before: sha256:aaa111, image_digest_after: sha256:bbb222

vikram (sre): making checklist for RCA write-up: timeline, customer impact table, metrics (queue depth, ready latency, HPA events), root cause hypothesis and evidence matrix, remediation + followups. Will coordinate write-up in #incidents once we have artifacts.

olivia (oncall): handing off — I'm stepping out in 10. @vikram take over monitoring until resolved. Leaving commands I ran in case you need to repeat:
```
# bump hpa max temporarily
kubectl patch hpa frontend-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'
# manual scale dedicated pool
redwoodctl pool scale --pool gpool-us-east-1 --size 18
# enable fallback routing
redwoodctl route update --route inference-prod --fallback-region us-west-2
```

vikram (sre): thanks — taking over. I'll keep thread updated. If anything degrades re-paging rule: escalate to eng-sre.

pager-team-bot: Reacts: :thumbsup: (olivia)

marco (runtime): quick note for later RCA — correlate image_digest_after (sha256:bbb222) with CI deploy on 2026-01-28 03:12 UTC. If confirmed, schedule revert/canary.

olivia (oncall): signing off. Marking thread with "handoff-complete".

vikram (sre): continuing collection now. Will post consolidated logs + timeline and assign owners on the RCA doc.
